0022600163.text: The 1-5 Chicago Bulls, who are on a four-game losing streak and 0-2 at home, visit the 6-1 Philadelphia 76ers, who lead the Atlantic Division and the East and have won three straight. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Bulls won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though Philadelphia won their most recent meeting 157-137 in Philadelphia on March 25. Nic Claxton is out for the Bulls with a hamstring injury, while the 76ers are missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Joel Embiid is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision.
